mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate cash flows and increasing the present value of equities, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over three consecutive months indicates weakening labor market conditions, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in residential construction starts below 1.2 million units over two consecutive months signals weakening household demand and reduced confidence in the housing market, which typically precedes a broader economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 105.0 for two consecutive months indicates weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in supply-side capacity, which signals an impending economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signal a broad-based collapse in household demand, which increases the probability of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 1200.0 and RSAFS < 490000.0 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 60% of interaction-triggered instances, or the interaction signal fails to outperform a single-series model in out-of-sample Rank IC tests.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 250.0 combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate indicates persistent inflationary pressure, which increases the likelihood of a prolonged monetary tightening cycle and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 250.0 and FEDFUNDS >= 1.5% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate above 4.3% and a decline in non-farm payroll growth below 50,000 jobs per month signals a labor market peak, which often precedes a slowdown in corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.3% and PAYEMS growth < 50.0 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal fails to achieve a positive Rank IC in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 490,000 million dollars combined with a contraction in GDP growth (GDPC1 < 0.5% annualized) signals a weakening demand environment, which increases the probability of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 490000.0 and GDPC1 < 0.5% (annualized) for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in fewer than 65% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal fails to maintain a Rank IC above 0.04 in any 3-year rolling window.
